description.value:
A lantern housing one stable ember of bound static. Crack the shutter and it hauls once on every Anchor in reach — nothing can take an ally standing inside that light, and the light does not last.

SIGNATURE — Named creatures in the emanation take scaling damage as the Anchor is wrenched against them — no attack roll, basic Will vs. your class DC; allies inside can't be possessed or Anchored until the start of your next turn.
